Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: Tailoring thickness debit for high-temperature fatigue resistance of Inconel 718 superalloy fabricated by laser powder bed fusion

Raw_Evidence_Span: Section 2.2: two groups of specimens designated HA1065 and HA1100 were homogenized at 1065 °C and 1100 °C for 1 h
Section 3.4: The average yield strength, ultimate tensile strength and fracture elongation were 1067.6 ± 81.1 MPa, 1215.7 ± 36.6 MPa and 9.1 ± 1.1 % for the HA1065 specimen

Nominal_Composition.Note: Chemical composition had been presented in previous work (Ma et al., 2022); not reproduced in this paper. Argon-atomized Inconel 718 powder with median diameter D50 = 24.10 μm was used.

Process_Text.original: Argon-atomized Inconel 718 powder was used to fabricate a block (60 mm × 45 mm × 45 mm) by LPBF (EOSINT M270D, EOS, Germany) with Yb fiber laser. Parameters: laser power 285 W, scanning speed 960 mm/s, hatch spacing 0.100 mm, layer thickness 0.040 mm, rotation angle 67°. Stress relief: heated at 600 °C for 2 h, furnace cooled. Homogenization at 1065 °C for 1 h. Two-step aging: 760 °C - 10 h / furnace cooling to 650 °C at 55 °C/h + 650 °C - 8 h / air cooling to RT. Specimens wire-electrical-discharge cut and ground and electropolished.
Process_Text.simplified: LPBF fabrication → stress relief (600 °C/2 h/FC) → homogenization (1065 °C/1 h) → two-step aging (760 °C/10 h + 650 °C/8 h) → wire-EDM cutting, machining and electropolishing

Equipment.Name: EOSINT M270D (EOS, Germany) with Yb fiber laser

Homogenization.Note: Designated as HA1065; based on AMS5664 specification

Structure_Text.original: HA1065 specimen consists of epitaxial columnar and V-shaped grains. ~94% of grains divided into (001), (101), (111) and (112) types. A small number of columnar grains with (001)//BD and a large amount of V-shaped grains with (101)//BD are distributed alternately. Many elongated Laves phases along dendritic boundaries, irregular particle-like Laves phases at GBs, rod-like or needle-like δ phases at GBs. Few spherical γ' phases and lots of ellipsoidal γ'' phases present.
Structure_Text.simplified: Columnar + V-shaped grains with mixed texture (001)//BD and (101)//BD; Laves, δ, γ'', γ' precipitates at grain/dendrite boundaries

Secondary_Phases.Morphology: elongated along dendritic boundaries and irregular particle-like at GBs
Secondary_Phases.Note: Crystal structure not explicitly stated in paper
Crystal structure not explicitly stated in paper
Often occurs in sandwiched configuration between two γ'' phases or side-by-side with single γ''
Few spherical γ' phases present; weak strengthening effect compared to γ'' usually ignored
